name: antigravity-seo
description: Comprehensive SEO plugin for Google Antigravity. 26 sub-skills (22 core + 1 orchestrator + 1 framework + 2 extension mirrors) and 19 sub-agents cover technical SEO, content quality (E-E-A-T), Schema.org markup, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals, AI search (GEO), agent readiness, local SEO, maps, backlinks, semantic clustering, SXO, drift monitoring, e-commerce, hreflang, and Google APIs. Includes optional MCP extensions, SPA-aware rendering, portability, and hardened SSRF/DNS-rebinding safe fetchers.
